name: Oxford Lane Capital Corp. 7.125% Series 2029 Term Preferred Stock
summary: Oxford Lane Capital Corp., a closed-end investment fund, is overseen by Oxford Lane Management LLC. This entity primarily allocates its capital to fixed income instruments. Its core investment strategy involves channeling funds into securitization vehicles, which subsequently acquire senior secured loans. These loans are extended to corporations possessing either unrated or sub-investment grade debt. Founded on June 9, 2010, Oxford Lane Capital Corp. is domiciled within the United States.
